headline: Chinese Stock Investors Remain on Sidelines Despite State Support Measures
summary: Chinese investors refrained from increasing equity bets this week as leveraged traders trimmed holdings to a one-year low, even after Beijing unveiled measures to shore up market confidence.
why: Retail and leveraged participation are key drivers of liquidity and sentiment in China's domestic stock exchanges.

impacts.name: Shanghai Composite
impacts.why: Lack of retail participation and reduced leverage limit market momentum despite state intervention.
